pages.text: The $(l)Dark Matter Shovel$() and $(l)Red Matter Shovel$() move earth quickly. Craft the Dark Matter Shovel from Dark Matter and diamonds, then upgrade it into the Red Matter Shovel.$(br2)Press $(l)V$() to charge.$(br2)$(l)Hidden abilities$()$(br)$(li)Right-click grass or dirt to flatten a whole area into paths, with the radius growing with charge.$(li)Right-click a campfire to put it out.$(li)Right-click sand, gravel or clay to vein-mine the deposit for free.$(li)Charged right-click digs out an area of blocks as well.$(br2)$(l)Server settings:$() server.items.disableAllRadiusMining.
